summary.text: Cedric Hayden is a Republican Oregon state senator for District 6, which his biography describes as spanning much of eastern Lane and Douglas Counties.
A dentist and business owner from Fall Creek, he founded the charity Caring Hands Worldwide in 2007.

paragraphs.text: Hayden grew up in rural Fall Creek, Oregon, in what his biography calls a sixth-generation pioneer family, and was born in 1968.
He graduated from the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Dentistry in 1994 after attending undergraduate school in Walla Walla, Washington, and joined the family dental practice.
From 1994 to 2009 he created Oregon's first statewide oral health network, which with his brothers provided dental service in 35 of Oregon's 36 counties, according to the page.
His biography says he completed the "Seven Summits" and "Grand Slam" between 2001 and 2007 by climbing the highest mountain on each continent and skiing to the North and South Poles.
In 2007 he and his wife, Julie, began Caring Hands Worldwide, which runs pro bono mobile dental clinics in rural Oregon and abroad.
He also operates a charter air service, a horse and cattle ranch, a heavy-equipment business focused on wildland fire, and a hospital-based dental practice for patients with special needs.
The biography, which was written while he was completing a second session as a state representative, says he served as vice chair of the House Committee for Health Care.
He lives in Fall Creek with Julie and their five children.
